I offer individual lessons tailored to your level, priorities and reasons for learning English.

## Pronunciation {#pronunciation}

Improve clarity, intelligibility and confidence when speaking English.

We can work on:

- English vowels and consonants.
- Connected speech and sound changes.
- Word stress, sentence stress and rhythm.
- Intonation and natural-sounding speech.
- Understanding different English accents.

## Professional English {#professional-english}

Develop the communication skills you need in the workplace.

- Meetings and professional conversations.
- Presentations and public speaking.
- Job interviews and networking.
- Explaining complex ideas clearly.
- Communicating across cultures.

## General English {#general-english}

Build your fluency and confidence through conversation, listening, vocabulary and focused language work.

Lessons can be adapted to your current level and the situations you encounter in daily life.

## Academic English

Develop the language skills needed to participate confidently in university life.

- Seminar discussion and contributions.
- Academic presentations.
- Speaking with lecturers and classmates.
- Understanding spoken English in lectures.

## How lessons work

1. We discuss your goals and current difficulties.
2. We identify the most useful areas to work on.
3. Lessons combine practical activities with targeted feedback.
4. We review progress and adjust the plan as you improve.
